description: Replicated first look at the composite Theta fit: the declared grid on the training hull under matched seeds, and the held-out hull at every grid point so the held-out score at the fitted Theta is read off after the fit, never used to choose it. Post-2021 eras are out of scope.

grid.note: Half-decade points from 1e4 to 1e9; the single-seed fit's grid with the midpoints added.

fit.note: Matched seeds: every candidate sees the same 20 seeds, so candidate differences are paired.

held_out.note: Scored at the fitted Theta and reported at its half-decade neighbours as sensitivity; the rest of the grid is stored, not scored.
